alignments.note: Assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12).

Participle מְנַצֵּחַ rendered Chief Musician. Headed on Chief under rule 31: dropping Chief loses the overseer/director lexeme of נָצַח, while Musician is a generic the ASV never writes alone for this word (or any Hebrew word), so it is the supplied completion and never the head, exactly as place is for בָּמָה → high place. Competing head: Musician, read as the class noun with Chief as specifier.
עַל rendered by the fixed phrase after the manner of; headed on the content word manner under rule 24, never on a connective.
Indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).

review_notes: Superscription. Head of Chief Musician moved from Musician to Chief under rule 31's subtraction and its ASV-usage tie-break (Musician is never written alone for נָצַח); competing head recorded in the unit note.
